messages:
ira: Heads-up: CS again — new users hitting the JS quickstart see `Error: Bad request` with no code/hint. Go/Python return `InvalidArgument` + friendly hint. This is creating onboarding churn.
ben: Oof. We intended typed exceptions across SDKs. Quick question: is this a JS SDK bug or sampleapp showing the wrong pattern?
sasha: Quick investigation: sampleapp README still shows `if err.type == 'InvalidArgument'` (Go-centric). JS SDK currently maps `body.message` -> Error.message and drops `code/human_message`.
oliver: Fix proposal (minimal): 1) JS SDK: parse canonical envelope `{code,human_message,hint,http_status,retry_after}` when present and throw Error subclasses (InvalidArgumentError, RateLimitError, ServerError) with those props; 2) sampleapp: update quickstart to prefer `instanceof` or `err.code` checks and remove `err.type` example; 3) add small compatibility shim to map legacy `message` shapes to new envelope for one release.
ira: Streaming edge: some streaming endpoints close with only a status. Suggest server add sentinel `x-rw-error: 1` header and a final newline-delimited JSON trailer when possible. If no body/trailer, SDKs should fall back to status->canonical-code mapping.
ben: Docs mapping table proposal (canonical codes): 400 -> InvalidArgument, 401 -> AuthenticationFailed, 403 -> PermissionDenied, 404 -> ResourceNotFound, 409 -> Conflict, 422 -> InvalidState, 429 -> RateLimit (includes retry_after seconds), 500..599 -> ServerError (retriable). Keep it prescriptive.
sasha: UX rule: `human_message` must be concise (<140 chars), non-technical, and include suggested next steps when appropriate. No stacks or model internals. Server must sanitize.
oliver: Tests: add an integration test in sampleapp CI that POSTs an oversized prompt to staging and asserts `err.code === 'InvalidArgument' && typeof err.human_message === 'string'`. Also add one streaming test simulating a trailer and one simulating no-body fallback.
ira: Owners: sasha -> JS SDK PR for error classes + compat shim (ETA: tomorrow EOD), oliver -> sampleapp + quickstart updates + CI tests (ETA: Fri), ben -> docs mapping + streaming trailer RFC (ETA: Thu).
docs-bot: Created task DEVEX-8400 "js-sdk error classes + onboarding parity" assigned to sasha. https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/8400
sasha: I'll also add a linter rule so constructing RedwoodError without `code` and `human_message` fails CI. Add changelog entry and small migration snippet for users.
ben: After deploy, CS will re-open affected tickets for verification. Let's keep the compat shim for one major release and log a deprecation warning when used.
ira: Thanks — small scope and big impact. Post PR links here and I'll coordinate CS follow-up. :thumbsup:
